I need to work out the time window. "within a year" means ±12 months or just +12 months? Given the rules about coarse dates as intervals, I'll treat it as a 12-month window around the session date. For the 4-5 year gap, that's 48-60 months between sessions.

For the pair matching, I'll define the gap as 48-60 months and find all valid session pairs within that range. Finally, I'll select the best pair per subject.
